The Moon packs her bags for Gemini tonight.

The Moon in Taurus squares Jupiter today and slips into Gemini tonight, while Mercury is retrograde in Scorpio. Swipe for Gemini, Libra and Aquarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Air friend. 🌙
